findings.title: forceError path untested
findings.detail: New forceError branch changes empty-submit behavior (suppress answer on success; setError on every resolution) but this commit only retargets meets_the_bar tests. No test covers forceError, the empty-submit call run('', emptyMessage, emptyMessage), or the success-vs-error branches. Behavior is asserted in comments only — unverified.

findings.title: forceError not forced on errors
findings.detail: Implementation is setError(outcome.status === 'error' ? outcome.message : forceError). Empty submit still surfaces arbitrary endpoint/network error text whenever status is error; only the success path is hard-pinned to emptyMessage. JSDoc frames forceError as what the panel shows 'however the request resolves,' which the error branch does not do.

findings.title: waived-unmeasured fail-closed
findings.detail: Absent rules are no longer dropped because they are waived. unmeasured and waivedUnmeasured are split and both emit reasons. Same-commit tests require the waived-missing id, the 'never measured' phrasing, two-line separation from plain unmeasured, and Map waivers. Gate hole fix is verified from this diff.

findings.title: measurement-meta not evidence for this fix
findings.detail: Only timestamps (and the same ok/knownBad outcomes) change for theme-paint and fe-search-present. Neither measurer exercises rubricCoverageReasons or useAssistantPanel empty submit. Re-stamping unrelated meta does not verify either code change.
